# Lumi Local

> Practical owner-first guides about local presence in Vietnam. Lumi supplies websites, owner-confirmed directions links and print-ready honest-review QR artwork. It does not create, verify or manage Google Business Profiles, and makes no ranking, lead or revenue guarantees.

## Publication
- [Vietnamese journal](https://local.runlumi.app/blog/)
- [English journal](https://local.runlumi.app/en/blog/)
- [Editorial policy](https://local.runlumi.app/blog/about/)
- [Vietnamese RSS](https://local.runlumi.app/blog/rss.xml)
- [English RSS](https://local.runlumi.app/en/blog/rss.xml)

## Scope and pricing
- [Lumi Local offer](https://local.runlumi.app/): Starter 1,990,000 VND year one. Optional Trust Kit 399,000 VND once, fully credited for upgrade within 30 days. Renewal from year two: 599,000 VND/year with RunLumi address or 999,000 VND/year with one standard custom domain. Confirm eligibility and cost before payment. Printing and physical stands excluded.

## Operator
- [RunLumi](https://runlumi.app/): Maintains Lumi Local.
